title: Creating a day-of-the-following-month term lists it after the Net terms
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Choose a name that no term has for the new term, term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Click the Day box.
  4. Type 10 in the Day box.
  5. Click "Create Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 3:

  • "Due day of the following month" is chosen.

Step 4:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 5:

  • The toast "term A created" shows.
  • Term A is listed after Net 120 and before Credit Hold, with Due "10th of the following month" and 0 customers and 0 vendors.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R7: “On Create, the window closes, a success toast shows "{name} created", and the term appears on the Active tab in its S1-R5 position, with 0 customers and 0 vendors, available at once in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • S1-R7, a day of the following month term: “A "day of the following month" term: "{ordinal day} of the following month", for example "10th of the following month", "1st of the following month", "22nd of the following month"”
